title: split router
description: Splits the body into parts and sends each part along the outbound link with rule split; the message itself continues on the other link.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the expression: xpath (//a), jsonpath ($.a[*]), tokenize (the text to split at), xtokenize (an XML element path or name) or simple (an expression that gives a list, such as ${body.split(',')})

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect yet

parallelProcessing.title: Parallel processing
parallelProcessing.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect yet (parts are processed one after another)

exchangePattern.title: Exchange pattern
exchangePattern.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect yet
